classes.name: Unvalidated runtime boundary shape
classes.description: A value reachable from parsing, deserialization, transport, plugins, providers, persistence or another process reaches an operation that assumes a runtime type or shape before validation.

classes.name: Unbounded work from untrusted boundary metadata
classes.description: Untrusted or optional metadata can trigger allocation, encoding, hashing, HMAC, parsing, iteration or other work proportional to attacker-controlled length before a cheap canonical bound is enforced.

classes.name: Semantic policy bypass through alternate representation or entry point
classes.description: Structurally valid data bypasses deny-by-default semantic classification, allowlisting, redaction, trust or egress policy through an alternate construction or call path.

classes.name: Optional context owns business liveness
classes.description: Malformed or absent observability/diagnostic context can abort, suppress, duplicate, reorder or otherwise change a valid business effect or delivery behavior.

classes.name: Evidence or authority provenance drift
classes.description: An evidence artifact, manifest, authority snapshot or immutable identity envelope can drift while validation still reports success.

classes.name: Durable assurance depends on expiring external evidence
classes.description: A durable promotion or accepted evidence state remains permanently dependent on temporary external artifacts or retention-limited live resources after admission, so unchanged steady-state validation can fail when those resources naturally expire.

classes.name: Cross-tenant correlation channel
classes.description: A raw or derived observable value remains globally joinable across tenant boundaries despite application-level tenant checks, including when a proof authenticates only a subset of the exported correlation representation.

classes.name: Representation mistaken for authority
classes.description: Formatting, equality, prefixes, origin, type or successful parsing is treated as proof of tenant scope, trust, authorization, provenance or identity.

classes.name: Proof issuance detached from protected operation
classes.description: A proof or attestation can be issued for caller-chosen state without proving that the protected transformation or validation actually occurred.

classes.name: Proof bound to the wrong semantic or representation identity
classes.description: A proof authenticates the wrong object or omits an explicitly governed representation companion, so legitimate representation changes break continuity or already-governed representation is transformed again.

classes.name: Incomplete canonical validation
classes.description: Input is structurally accepted while unsupported versions, duplicate fields, invalid grammar, non-encodable text or other non-canonical representations remain possible and may escape the intended fail-closed observability path or reach encoding work without canonical shape validation.

classes.name: Missing boundary trust context
classes.description: A propagated field is validated without the boundary-owned source, trust, classification, hop-scope or egress decision needed by policy.

classes.name: Learning reconciliation surface, trigger or freshness gap
classes.description: A channel or trigger capable of carrying a material review finding is omitted, misbound, non-strict, unusable, or allowed to publish stale success after newer evidence, so the learning gate can report coverage that does not correspond to the latest complete review state.

classes.name: Declared learning guardrail is not proven executable and effective
classes.description: The learning ledger can claim a permanent guardrail using textual presence, generic assertions, statically dead branches, no-op bodies, or entrypoint/call paths that are syntactically present but do not execute a registered negative test.

classes.name: Assurance write authority exposed to pull-request-controlled execution
classes.description: A workflow, runner state, command parser or endpoint allowlist permits pull-request-controlled execution to influence a context with write authority, or permits an implicit or spoofed mutation to escape the exact trusted publication boundary.
